• Access to S-pushTAN is protected by a password you have chosen and optionally by Touch ID or Face ID.
• The app automatically locks after a short period of time, which means that your data is secured as much as possible even if the iPhone or iPad gets lost.
• The German TÜV confirms these highest safety standards every year anew.

WORTH TO KNOW
• In order to be able to use pushTAN, you need an activation by your Sparkasse and a registration letter for the first setup.
• In order to use the current version of the app, you need iOS from version 13 on your iPhone or iPad.
• If your iPhone or iPad is jailbroken, S-pushTAN is not executable on it. The important high security standards for the mobile banking we offer cannot be guaranteed on manipulated devices.
• Please do not deny S-pushTAN any of the requested permissions when setting it up, as these are necessary for the smooth functioning of the app.
